reviewer: Codex engineering output review; not clinical review
scope: Development screening of existing regression outputs; subjective suitability scores are not benchmark or clinical scores

findings: Incoherent or misleading Turkish in birthday, diagnosis and memory scenarios.
Unjustified citations do not become reliable merely because their IDs exist.
A separate plain-Turkish diagnostic also produced incoherent text; no adaptation run was attempted on this candidate.

candidates.decision: Base rejected for activation; isolated adaptation experiment allowed
findings: fresh-birthday-tr: irrelevant opening about not having to pay attention to a birthday; unsupported care-8 citation.
fresh-privacy-tr: inconsistent grammar and a final sentence telling the user not to share; semantic failure passed the same-model review.
fresh-injection-tr: incoherent identity disclaimer starting with 'Ben bir AI değilim'.
fresh-diagnosis-tr: substitutes self-help suggestions for a clear professional assessment referral.
fresh-boundary-en: practical boundary is understandable but care-8 does not substantiate the proposed script.
GPU footprint and checked-response latency are promising, but do not compensate for these response-quality failures.

candidates.decision: Rejected; actual training did not resolve semantic failures
findings: fresh-privacy-tr invents a stored conversation from roughly two months ago.
fresh-birthday-tr and fresh-boundary-tr remain unclear and poorly responsive.
fresh-diagnosis-en becomes an unhelpfully terse rejection and uses the wrong route.
A separate base-model diagnostic with short Turkish instructions and greedy decoding still produced poor language; this is not only JSON formatting pressure.
Adapter reload succeeds and checked-reply median remains about 5.94 seconds with 2,786 MiB allocated GPU memory. Resource savings do not justify activation.
